note: Trimmed snapshots of live feeds fetched on the creation date (round 2 feeds and rdap-cache.json on the update date). URLs and domains are stored defanged. rdap-samples.json holds the real IANA bootstrap (trimmed) and two real RDAP answers used by the offline tests.

synthetic.urlhaus-recent.json: Synthetic sample in URLhaus API format (the API needs an Auth-Key). RFC 5737 IPs and .example/.test names only; hashes are made up.
synthetic.threatfox-iocs.json: Synthetic sample in ThreatFox API format (the API needs an Auth-Key). RFC 5737 IPs and .example names only; hashes are made up.
synthetic.otx-pulses.json: Synthetic sample in OTX pulses API format (the API needs a key). RFC 5737 IPs and .example names only; the hash is made up.
